summary: I mapped CI, checks and deploys on main and platform, reading files only. CI is two workflows. ci.yml has five jobs: test, judge, webkit, secrets and security. tap-interop.yml runs only when paths match. Platform adds two CI steps to main: `npm run test:d1` in the test job and `console.check.ts` in the judge job. Every browser check is a plain `npx tsx` Playwright script, not a vitest test, and serves its pages in-process. The kit11 Worker is deployed with `npm run relay:deploy` (worker/wrangler.jsonc, Worker `kit11`, Durable Object binding `RELAY`). The repo documents no rollback. Purser Cloud (cloud/wrangler.jsonc, Worker `purser-cloud`, D1 `purser-cloud` bound as `DB`, R2 bucket `purser-cloud-docs` bound as `DOCS`) has never been deployed: its `database_id` is still a placeholder, and `RP_ID` and `ORIGIN` are `cloud.example.invalid`. cloud/ is not its own package. There is no CodeQL workflow file, although deck.ts says CodeQL runs in CI. Local collisions come from fixed default ports (`relay --local` and `payables` both default to 4400) and from shared output folders (`coverage/`, `test-results/`, `worker/src/pages.gen.ts`, `data/kit11.sqlite`).

how_it_works:
CI runs on every push and every pull request; all actions are pinned by SHA, on Node 22.22.0 and ubuntu-24.04. The tests use fakes, so CI needs no secrets. A vitest setupFile strips keys and blocks the network.

Browser checks are standalone Playwright 1.63.0 scripts (`npx tsx test/browser/X.check.ts [outdir]`). Each starts its own server in-process on port 0, either through startJudge(0) or startLocalRelay({port:0}), except console.check, which picks a random 8790-8889 port. Playwright then drives Chromium or WebKit. A virtual authenticator over CDP stands in for the passkey in Chromium; a software passkey does so in WebKit (support/softPasskey.ts).

The kit11 Worker deploys locally with `npm run relay:deploy`, which uses worker/'s pinned wrangler and needs Cloudflare credentials. CI never deploys.

Purser Cloud is a second Worker defined in cloud/wrangler.jsonc. Its code lives in the root package, and it borrows wrangler from worker/ (`$schema` and test:d1 both point there). Its schema is applied two ways: by the D1 migration, and idempotently on first request (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS via ensureSchema).

answers.question: 1) .github/workflows/*: each job and what it runs
answers.answer:
ci.yml (runs on push and pull_request; permissions contents:read).

- **test** (15 min): `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, then installs xmllint (libxml2-utils) for test/iso20022.test.ts. Restores the Playwright Chromium cache (`~/.cache/ms-playwright`, keyed on package-lock) or runs `npx playwright install chromium`. Then `npm run test:coverage`, which is `vitest run --coverage && tsx test/coverage-areas.ts`. Platform only: next comes `npm run test:d1`. Then `npm run relay:pages`; in worker/: `npm ci && npx tsc --noEmit && npm audit --audit-level=low`; then the root `npm audit --audit-level=low`.
- **judge** (15 min): `npm ci`, `npm run judge -- --check`, the Chromium cache, then three checks: `npx tsx test/browser/pages.check.ts test-results/pages`, `npx tsx test/browser/trace.check.ts test-results/trace` and `npx tsx test/browser/trysign.check.ts test-results/trysign`. Platform only: `npx tsx test/browser/console.check.ts test-results/console`.
- **webkit** (15 min): `npm ci` on the runner, then `docker run --rm --ipc=host -v $PWD:/repo -w /repo mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble@sha256:eff16c30… npx tsx test/browser/trysign-webkit.check.ts test-results/trysign-webkit`.
- **secrets** (10 min, fetch-depth 0): `gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v2.3.9` on the pushed commits, then a whole-history scan: `docker run ghcr.io/gitleaks/gitleaks:v8.24.3@sha256:e1b35e… git /repo --redact --verbose --no-banner --gitleaks-ignore-path /repo/.gitleaksignore`.
- **security** (15 min): `npm ci`; SBOM via `npm sbom --sbom-format cyclonedx --omit dev`, asserting it is non-empty; Semgrep 1.180.0 in a venv with `--config p/typescript p/nodejs p/secrets p/owasp-top-ten .semgrep/purser.yml` over src and worker/src. It fails on any finding or if no rules loaded.

tap-interop.yml has one job, **interop** (20 min). It runs on push or PR touching src/visa/**, src/db/**, src/provenance/**, src/agents/cardBuyer.ts, test/interop/**, the workflow itself or package*.json, and on workflow_dispatch. Steps: clone visa/trusted-agent-protocol at TAP_REF_COMMIT 16d59bdf… into RUNNER_TEMP; npm install the cdn-proxy with `--before=2026-10-19`; pip install with hashes from test/interop/tap-ref-requirements.txt (Python 3.12); start the registry on 127.0.0.1:9002 (sqlite in RUNNER_TEMP) and the proxy on 3001; run `npx tsx test/interop/tap-interop.ts` (our merchant on :3000); on failure, print the reference logs.

Dependabot (dependabot.yml): weekly npm updates for / and /worker, plus github-actions.

answers.question: 2) package.json scripts: every check/run script with one line each (note main vs platform differences)
answers.answer:
**Platform vs main.** Platform has every main script. Platform-only: `cloud:font` (writes cloud/src/font.gen.ts), `cloud:pdfjs` (copies unpdf's pdf.js into cloud/public/assets), `test:d1` (`CLOUD_DB=d1 vitest run --config vitest.d1.config.ts`), `e2e:live` (platform end-to-end; dry run by default, `--live` also needs E2E_LIVE=yes and E2E_BUDGET), `ledger` (Purser's own books, UI on PORT or 4500), `erp` (Exact Online, Business Central or Odoo sync), `payables` (local page on 127.0.0.1:4400), `vault` (files into data/vault) and `cloud` (push|mail to Purser Cloud). One script differs: `lint` is `eslint src test examples` on main and adds `cloud/src` on platform.

**Checks.**
- `test`: vitest run.
- `test:coverage`: vitest with coverage, then the per-area 90% floor.
- `typecheck`: tsc --noEmit (platform's tsconfig includes cloud/src).
- `lint`: eslint.
- `judge`: offline jury server on PORT or 4311; `-- --check` fetches every page and exits.
- `relay:pages`: writes worker/src/pages.gen.ts.
- `sbom`: writes docs/security/sbom.cdx.json.
- `verify`: re-checks everything from sources a judge can reach.
- `verify-log` and `verify-receipt`: offline verification.
- `origins`: exits 1 if any money movement has no origin.
- `health`: are outside systems reachable (live).
- `data-qa`: ledger vs Airwallex (read-only GETs).
- `dashboard-vs-chain`: dashboard numbers vs Metal.
- `awx-readback`: Airwallex ids in the docs, read back from the sandbox.
- `reconcile`: light hourly reconciliation.
- `smoke:sandbox`.
- `budget`: API budget counters.

**Evals and red team (real Claude, needs keys).** `evals`, `agent-evals`, `model-bench`, `holdouts`, `blind-holdouts`, `variation`, `variation-live`, `autonomy-variation`, `autonomy-redteam`, `redteam`, `redteam-night`, `reliability` (PORT or 4466), `clearing-load`.

**Run and serve.**
- `relay`: runner; `--local` serves on KIT11_RELAY_PORT or 4400.
- `up`: health checks, then the runner, kept up.
- `dashboard`: 127.0.0.1:4300.
- `approvals`: local approval page, PORT or 4200.
- `devtest`: one dev proposal to approve.
- `relay:deploy`: deploys the kit11 Worker.
- `mcp`: agent API over stdio.
- `outside-agent`, `agent`, `world`, `lab`.
- `visa`: PORT or 4410.
- `visa:tap-live`: PORT or 3000.

**Live scenario and ops (live rails and keys).** `bootstrap`, `trade`, `s1:raise`, `s1:resume`, `s2`, `s3`, `licence`, `demo:all`, `fail`, `fraud`, `inject`, `four-eyes`, `passkey-owners`, `owners`, `compliance-policy`, `receivables`, `card-payment`, `test-funds`, `awx-1`, `airi:vic-1`, `airi:vic-2`, `two-locks`, `proposals`, `approve`, `principals`, `passkey`, `policy`, `pause`, `stop`, `rebalance`, `cards`, `ask`, `payee`, `receive-policy`, `clearing`, `dispute`, `t0`.

**Exports and records.** `audit:export`, `audit:report`, `books`, `gl`, `iso20022`, `month-end-pack`, `demo:record`, `demo-tower`, `autonomy-record`, `trace-record`, `record-try-agents`, `agent-summary`, `submission`, `social-preview`, `video`, `contracts` (compiles ComplianceSendPolicy.sol with pinned solc 0.8.36).

answers.question: 3) vitest configs (pool, workers, the d1 config), how long the full suite takes locally if recorded, known flaky tests
answers.answer:
**vitest.config.ts** (the same on main and platform; vitest 5.0.5):
- No `pool`, `maxWorkers` or `fileParallelism` set, so vitest defaults apply (forks pool, workers from CPU count).
- `exclude: [...configDefaults.exclude, '.claude/**']`.
- `setupFiles: ['test/support/noNetwork.ts']`.
- `coverage`: provider v8, include src/**/*.ts, reporters text-summary and json-summary, reportsDirectory 'coverage'.

**vitest.d1.config.ts** (platform only): mergeConfig of the base. It includes test/cloud-*.test.ts, test/rt4-cloud-*.test.ts and test/ap-credit-netting.test.ts, with setupFiles ['test/support/d1.ts'], testTimeout 60_000 and hookTimeout 120_000.

**d1 setup.** When CLOUD_DB=d1, it requires wrangler from worker/ (run `npm ci --prefix worker` first) and calls getPlatformProxy with persist:false. Each test file gets 160 throwaway D1 databases and one R2 bucket in a mkdtemp folder.

**Size.** 302 test files on main and 385 on platform. Release notes record '2447 tests in 251 files, all passing'.

**Wall-clock time.** Unknown: not recorded in the repo. The test and judge jobs each have a 15-minute timeout.

**Flaky tests.** No list of flaky tests is kept. Two were fixed in code:
- test/ap-redteam2.test.ts:208 (pdfText with a 1 ms timeout was sometimes beaten by a warm worker).
- test/cloud-core.test.ts:31 (a key secret containing '_').

Timing-sensitive candidates under parallel load (inferred, not documented):
- process-spawning tests: test/runner-stop-real.test.ts, test/dispute-carryout-real.test.ts, test/cloud-cli-exit.test.ts, test/airi-tap-watch.test.ts
- the Chromium-driven test/airi-hosted-checkout.test.ts

answers.question: 4) Browser checks: pages.check, redesign.check, trysign.check, trace.check, console.check, webkit: what each does and how it serves pages
answers.answer:
None of these run under vitest. Each is run as `npx tsx test/browser/<x>.check.ts [screenshot dir]` and writes screenshots to that dir (CI uses test-results/<x>). Every check fails on console or page errors.

**pages.check.ts** (CI: judge). Guest pages with no key: /, /?recorded (also &agents, &books, &disputes), /live and /demo redirects, /month, /runs, /agents/*, /metal/report and others. Widths 360, 390, 768 and 1440; light and dark. Fails on console or page errors, 'null', 'undefined' or 'NaN' on screen, horizontal overflow, a11y faults (no lang, not exactly one h1, nameless controls, missing alt) and a wrapping menu.
- Serves: `startJudge(0)`, plus `startLocalRelay({port:0, token:'pages-check'})` built with TRY_SIGN_ENABLED=on for /judge and /try/sign.
- `--live <url>`: runs against the hosted relay instead.

**redesign.check.ts** (not in CI). The four tabs (Home, Watch, Try, Proof) at 390 and 1440, light and dark. Fails on CSP violations, text under 14px and internal links that are not 200.
- Serves: `startJudge(0)`.

**trysign.check.ts** (CI: judge). The /try/sign five-screen story at 360, 390 and 1440, light and dark: sign with a Chromium CDP virtual authenticator, then tamper attempts (one cent, another IBAN, currency, FX) refused, a looser rule signed, the next invoice paid alone. Also: the receipt verified offline, word and button budgets per screen, the full policy panel, markup shown as text, and one timed visit of at most 75 s.
- Serves: `startLocalRelay({port:0, token:'browser-check', trySignFx: stand-in, trySignAdvisor: stand-in, trySignReader: stand-in, trySignRecorded:null})` with TRY_SIGN_ENABLED=on.
- `--live [base]`: runs against https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev at 390 light and 1440 dark only. It stops if /try/sign is not deployed.

**trace.check.ts** (CI: judge). The agent trace dialog at 390 and 1440, light and dark: five steps, the refused call named, the Metal tx link, hashes, Escape closes and focus returns.
- Serves: `dashboardApp(openDb(':memory:'), …).listen(0,'127.0.0.1')`, after runAgent with a fake Anthropic client.

**console.check.ts** (platform; CI: judge). The Purser Cloud console: a test company set up from its starter key, a virtual passkey first run and sign-in, the runner's test world pushed via pushToCloud, then every page at 1440 and 390. Fails if HTML in a supplier name renders as markup, on CSP or console errors, on overflow, and if an ended session does not go back to sign-in.
- Serves: a node `createServer` over cloud `handle()` with `sqliteSql(':memory:')`, `dirBlobs(mkdtemp)` and pdf.js from unpdf.
- Port: `8790 + random(0..99)` on 127.0.0.1, so a collision is possible.

**trysign-webkit.check.ts** (CI: webkit job, in the Playwright docker image). The same story in WebKit at 360, 390 and 1440 using an injected software ES256 passkey (test/browser/support/softPasskey.ts). Also checks that the page offers nothing when WebAuthn is absent.
- Serves: `startLocalRelay({port:0, token:'browser-check-webkit'})` with TRY_SIGN_ENABLED=on.

**Others (not in CI).**
- approve.check.ts: phone approval pages; `--live` available.
- root.check.ts: the / routing.
- headers.check.ts: security headers with no browser; `--live <url>` checks the hosted relay.
- dryrun.check.ts: a live runbook dry run that needs KIT11_DB, KIT11_KEYS_DIR and dry-* worlds.

answers.question: 5) Secret scanning: gitleaks config and the .gitleaksignore convention; CodeQL
answers.answer:
**gitleaks config.** There is no .gitleaks.toml, so gitleaks' default rules apply. CI runs gitleaks twice:
- gitleaks-action v2.3.9 on the pushed or PR commits (needs GITHUB_TOKEN and pull-requests:read).
- A whole-history scan with the pinned image ghcr.io/gitleaks/gitleaks:v8.24.3@sha256:e1b35e…, run as `git /repo --redact --verbose --no-banner --gitleaks-ignore-path /repo/.gitleaksignore`.

**.gitleaksignore convention** (identical on main and platform, 84 lines):
- One accepted finding per line, as the fingerprint `<commit sha>:<path>:<rule id>:<line>`.
- A `#` comment above each group says why it is not a secret and that it was checked by hand (fake test values, variable names, public hashes, public contract addresses).
- A new false positive gets its fingerprint (from the gitleaks output) plus a justifying comment. Code that tripped a rule was rewritten to build fake values at run time.

**Semgrep** also covers secrets via p/secrets, plus the project's own .semgrep/purser.yml.

**CodeQL.** There is no CodeQL workflow in .github/workflows on either branch. Only code comments mention it ('CodeQL: reflected input', 'missing rate limit', 'multi-character sanitization', in src/agents/askPurser.ts, src/airi/hostedCheckout.ts and platform's src/servers/payables.ts). The deck (src/submission/deck.ts:194) claims CodeQL runs in CI. Presumably it is GitHub's default setup in the repository settings; unknown from the snapshot.

answers.question: 6) Deploy of the kit11 Worker: what npm run relay:deploy does, wrangler config path, worker name, bindings, env names it needs, post-deploy checks, rollback options
answers.answer:
**What `npm run relay:deploy` does** (`tsx src/cli/relay-deploy.ts`, run from the repo root):
1. Exits with code 2 unless CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID are set.
2. Gets the token from `relayToken()`: KIT11_RELAY_TOKEN, else an HMAC derived from CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN. Since 2 Nov it is a random token kept outside git; a runbook passes it as `KIT11_RELAY_TOKEN=$(cat …/relay-token)`.
3. Writes worker/src/pages.gen.ts with `pagesModule(buildPages())`. TRY_SIGN_ENABLED is read at this build step; on, the bundle includes /try/sign.
4. Runs `npm ci` in worker/ if worker/node_modules/.bin/wrangler is missing.
5. Runs `wrangler deploy` in worker/ with WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false.
6. Runs `wrangler secret put RELAY_TOKEN`, passing the token on stdin.
7. Fetches `${relayConfig().url}/api/snapshot` and prints the status (503 means it is waiting for the runner). The URL is KIT11_RELAY_URL, or the account's workers.dev subdomain looked up via the Cloudflare API.
8. Warns that the Durable Object keeps old code until idle: stop `npm run relay` for about a minute.

**Config.** worker/wrangler.jsonc, the same on main and platform: Worker name `kit11`, main src/index.ts, compatibility_date 2026-10-01, workers_dev true, preview_urls false. Binding: Durable Object `RELAY`, class `RelayObject`, migration tag v1 new_sqlite_classes. There are no vars in the file. Live URL: https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev.

**Env names** (worker/src/index.ts `Env`):
- Secret set by the deploy: RELAY_TOKEN.
- Set by hand: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, AIRWALLEX_CLIENT_ID and AIRWALLEX_API_KEY (scoped sandbox key for the /try/sign FX quote), and AIRWALLEX_WEBHOOK_SECRET (set by `npm run cards -- webhook`).
- Switches set by hand: TRY_SIGN_AGENTS ('off' stops the live agents) and TRY_SIGN_HAIKU (the old name, still honoured).
- Vars: MFA_SESSIONS='on' and LIVE_RUN='on'.
- Deploy-time env: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, KIT11_RELAY_TOKEN, optionally KIT11_RELAY_URL, and TRY_SIGN_ENABLED (build-time).

**Post-deploy checks** (manual; CI never deploys):
- `npx tsx test/browser/headers.check.ts --live https://kit11.max-31b.workers.dev`
- `npx tsx test/browser/pages.check.ts <dir> --live <url>`
- `npx tsx test/browser/trysign.check.ts --live [base] [dir]`
- `npx tsx test/browser/approve.check.ts --live`
- the probe /api/snapshot plus /health.

**Rollback.** No procedure is documented in the repo. Options:
- Check out the previous commit and run `npm run relay:deploy` again (the same token keeps the viewer links).
- Wrangler 4's `wrangler rollback` or `wrangler versions` / `wrangler deployments list`, run in worker/ (not referenced by the repo).

Either way, the Durable Object's SQLite state is not rolled back.

answers.question: 7) Deploy of the Purser Cloud preview: commands, wrangler config, D1/R2 names, how the D1 schema is migrated, env names
answers.answer:
The repo has no 'preview' deploy. docs/cloud.md says 'Not deployed yet; test money only', and the deploy is planned 'after 15 November, on Max's word'.

**Config:** platform/cloud/wrangler.jsonc.
- Worker name `purser-cloud`, main src/worker.ts, compatibility_date 2026-10-01, compatibility_flags [nodejs_compat], workers_dev false, preview_urls false.
- D1: binding `DB`, database_name `purser-cloud`, database_id `SET-AFTER-wrangler-d1-create` (a placeholder), migrations_dir `migrations`.
- R2: binding `DOCS`, bucket `purser-cloud-docs`, jurisdiction eu.
- Vars: RP_ID and ORIGIN, both placeholders `cloud.example.invalid`.
- Assets: ./public as `ASSETS`, run_worker_first.
- Cron: `17 3 * * *` (retention purge).

**Commands** (docs/cloud.md lines 229-258), run from the repo root:
1. `npx wrangler d1 create purser-cloud --location weur`
2. `npx wrangler r2 bucket create purser-cloud-docs --jurisdiction eu`
3. Paste the database_id into the config, then `npx wrangler d1 migrations apply purser-cloud --remote -c cloud/wrangler.jsonc`
4. `npx wrangler secret put SESSION_SECRET -c cloud/wrangler.jsonc` (48+ characters) and `npx wrangler secret put ADMIN_TOKEN_SHA256 -c cloud/wrangler.jsonc`
5. Set the route and RP_ID/ORIGIN; set up Email Routing with a catch-all to the Worker and set MAIL_DOMAIN.
6. `npm run cloud:pdfjs`, then `npx wrangler deploy -c cloud/wrangler.jsonc`.

**Caveat.** The root package.json has no wrangler dependency, so a root `npx wrangler` resolves to an unpinned download. Use `worker/node_modules/.bin/wrangler … -c cloud/wrangler.jsonc` to stay pinned (4.155.0).

**Schema.** There is a single migration, cloud/migrations/0001_init.sql. cloud/src/schema.ts holds the same SQL as the generated `SCHEMA` string; test/cloud-core.test.ts asserts they are equal. The Worker also runs `ensureSchema()` (cloud/src/app.ts:453) on first request, using CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS. There is no ALTER and no tooling for migrations past 0001: the schema.ts header says 'edit the .sql file and regenerate', but no regenerate script was found (unknown).

**Env names** (cloud/src/worker.ts `Bindings`):
- Bindings: DB, DOCS, ASSETS.
- Secrets: SESSION_SECRET (must be at least 32 characters or every request throws) and ADMIN_TOKEN_SHA256.
- Vars: RP_ID, ORIGIN, MAIL_DOMAIN (optional), VERSION (optional, shown by /v1/health).
- Runner side: PURSER_CLOUD_URL and PURSER_CLOUD_KEY for `npm run cloud -- push|mail`.

**Backups.** GET /v1/export, with `importTenant` (cloud/src/restore.ts) as a library function only, plus D1 Time Travel (not rehearsed).

answers.question: 8) Is cloud/ a separate package with its own dependencies?
answers.answer:
No. cloud/ has no package.json or lockfile. It contains migrations/, public/ (filled by cloud:pdfjs), scripts/ (font.ts, pdfjs.ts), src/ and wrangler.jsonc.

Its code is part of the root package:
- The root tsconfig includes cloud/src, and platform's lint covers it.
- It uses root dependencies (e.g. unpdf 1.9.1, better-sqlite3 via cloud/src/node.ts for local and test runs).
- Tests live in the root test/ (cloud-*.test.ts).

The only toolchain it borrows is wrangler and its schema from worker/ (`$schema: ../worker/node_modules/wrangler/config-schema.json`; test/support/d1.ts requires wrangler via worker/package.json).

worker/ is the one separate package (x402-business-agents-relay: wrangler 4.155.0 and @cloudflare/workers-types), with its own lockfile, Dependabot entry and npm audit in CI.

answers.question: 9) Anything that makes parallel local test runs collide (ports, shared temp files, sqlite paths) and how to avoid it
answers.answer:
**Vitest itself is mostly isolated.** Servers listen on port 0, ledgers use ':memory:' or mkdtemp paths (74 test files use mkdtempSync), and d1.ts uses mkdtemp with persist:false.

Collision points:
1. **coverage/.** `npm run test:coverage` always writes coverage/, and coverage-areas.ts reads coverage/coverage-summary.json. Two runs in one checkout clobber each other: use separate worktrees or `--coverage.reportsDirectory`.
2. **worker/src/pages.gen.ts.** Overwritten by relay:pages, relay:deploy and the page bundle build. Parallel builds or deploys race on it.
3. **Fixed default ports in CLIs.**
   - judge: PORT or 4311 (`npm run judge -- --check` collides between parallel runs; set PORT).
   - dashboard: 4300. approvals: 4200.
   - payables: PORT or 4400, and relay --local: KIT11_RELAY_PORT or 4400. These two collide with each other.
   - visa: 4410. ledger: 4500. reliability: 4466.
   - visa:tap-live and the tap-interop merchant: 3000; the TAP reference uses 9002 and 3001.
   Set PORT or KIT11_RELAY_PORT per run.
4. **console.check.ts.** Picks 8790 plus random(0..99) with no retry: about a 1% collision chance per pair of parallel runs, failing with EADDRINUSE.
5. **Screenshot dirs.** test-results/<x> (or out/try-sign-live for trysign --live) are shared: pass a distinct dir argument.
6. **Default ledger.** `openDb()` falls back to KIT11_DB or data/kit11.sqlite (test/fixtures/world-runner.ts calls openDb() but gets KIT11_DB from its parent test). Any CLI run without KIT11_DB shares data/kit11.sqlite and its runner lock; always set KIT11_DB=data/<unique>.sqlite and KIT11_KEYS_DIR.
7. **CPU and timeouts.** Running `npm test` and `npm run test:d1` at the same time starts many forks plus workerd: expect timeouts in process-spawning and Chromium-driven tests. Limit with `vitest run --maxWorkers=N`.
8. **The Playwright browser cache** (~/.cache/ms-playwright) is shared but read-only at run time: fine.

Safest pattern: one git worktree per parallel run (vitest already excludes .claude/** for agent worktrees), unique PORT and KIT11_DB values, and a unique screenshot dir.

extension_points.what: Add a new browser check to CI (e.g. the jury demo world or the public Cloud demo world)
extension_points.how: Add a step `npx tsx test/browser/<name>.check.ts test-results/<name>`. Serve in-process with startJudge(0), startLocalRelay({port:0,…}) or cloud handle() on port 0; avoid fixed ports.

extension_points.what: Deploy a public read-only Cloud demo world
extension_points.how: Add a separate wrangler env or config with its own D1 and R2 names and RP_ID/ORIGIN. Apply the migration with `--remote -c`, set the SESSION_SECRET and ADMIN_TOKEN_SHA256 secrets, and run cloud:pdfjs before deploy. Use worker/'s pinned wrangler.

extension_points.what: Ship /try/sign changes to the live kit11 site
extension_points.how: Run `TRY_SIGN_ENABLED=on npm run relay:deploy` with CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and KIT11_RELAY_TOKEN set. Then run `trysign.check.ts --live`, `pages.check.ts --live` and `headers.check.ts --live`.

extension_points.what: Run cloud tests on D1 locally
extension_points.how: `npm ci --prefix worker && npm run test:d1`. A new cloud test file must match test/cloud-*.test.ts or test/rt4-cloud-*.test.ts to be included.

Currently only 0001_init with CREATE IF NOT EXISTS, kept equal to SCHEMA by test/cloud-core.test.ts. A 0002 migration needs a decision on how ensureSchema handles ALTERs; no regenerate script was found.

extension_points.what: Accept a new gitleaks false positive
extension_points.how: Append the fingerprint `<sha>:<path>:<rule>:<line>` with a `#` comment explaining why it is not a secret; better, rewrite the code so the value is built at run time.

pinned_by_tests.pins: 90% line coverage floor per area (money, policy, passkey, executors, relay, clearing); CI fails below it.
SCHEMA in cloud/src/schema.ts equals cloud/migrations/0001_init.sql byte for byte, and every statement is CREATE TABLE/INDEX.
Every CHECK_PATHS page answers 200 with more than 1000 bytes offline, with no keys.
Zero findings and more than zero rules across p/typescript, p/nodejs, p/secrets, p/owasp-top-ten and .semgrep/purser.yml over src and worker/src.
No unlisted secret anywhere in git history.
No script in the repo sets ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or the AIRWALLEX_* Worker secrets.

pinned_by_tests.check: worker npm ci && tsc --noEmit && npm audit --audit-level=low; root npm audit --audit-level=low
pinned_by_tests.pins: The Worker type-checks against the generated pages.gen.ts, and there are no known vulnerabilities at low or above.

runtime_constraints: Node 22.22.0 in CI; engines '^22.13.0 || >=23.4.0'. Playwright 1.63.0, vitest 5.0.5, wrangler 4.155.0 (worker/ only).
Playwright Chromium is needed for npm test as well (test/airi-hosted-checkout.test.ts drives headless Chromium).
test:d1 needs `npm ci --prefix worker` (wrangler and workerd); no network or Cloudflare account.
Linux Playwright WebKit has no WebAuthn; the WebKit check injects a software passkey (softPasskey.ts).
The suite blocks non-local network and strips live keys (test/support/noNetwork.ts via setupFiles and NODE_OPTIONS in child processes).
relay:deploy needs CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and KIT11_RELAY_TOKEN. The token file lives outside git, and a fresh container means a new token and new viewer links.
After a kit11 deploy, the Durable Object keeps old code until idle (about a minute without the runner or dashboard).
risks: The Cloud deploy docs use a root `npx wrangler`, but the root package has no wrangler dependency, so it runs an unpinned version; use worker/node_modules/.bin/wrangler.
cloud/wrangler.jsonc still has a placeholder database_id and RP_ID/ORIGIN set to cloud.example.invalid. A deploy without editing them fails, or binds passkeys to the wrong host.

There is no schema migration path past 0001_init. ensureSchema() only does CREATE IF NOT EXISTS, so new columns will not reach an existing D1 database unless a 0002 migration is applied with `wrangler d1 migrations apply`.
There is no documented rollback for the kit11 Worker, and Durable Object state does not roll back with the code.
The CodeQL claim in the deck has no workflow file in the repo; verify it in the GitHub settings before relying on it.
console.check.ts uses a random fixed port range with no retry, so EADDRINUSE is possible in parallel runs.
Merging platform into main brings test:d1 and console.check into CI, adding a worker/ install to the test job and roughly 83 more test files (385 vs 302).
